up: Retrieve the molecule ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), exact activity values (standard_value, standard_units), and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4649968. Filter activities to include only exact measurements where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is not null. Return all matching rows without applying a row limit. Do not filter on assay confidence score, organism, or document type.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, cs.canonical_smiles FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649968' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
